summary: Backend-only iteration 3 verified the /api/memories/generate error-handling fix for exhausted Emergent Universal LLM key budget. Confirmed the endpoint now returns HTTP 402 (a proper 4xx that survives Kubernetes ingress rewriting) with a JSON body: {"detail": "You're out of AI image credits. Add balance to your Emergent Universal Key (Profile → Universal Key → Add Balance), then try again."} — NOT 502, NOT a generic 'Something went wrong'. Validation branches (empty prompt, missing photo_ids, invalid photo_ids) still return 400 with JSON detail. Full regression pass: OTP auth flow (request-otp → hashed store → verify-otp → session_token → /auth/me), Photos CRUD with the OTP-issued Bearer token, memories list, and auth-gating on all endpoints. 35 passed, 3 skipped (skipped tests are downstream of a real 200-generation which can't run while budget is exhausted — expected).

minor.issue: Error classification is substring-based on the lowercased exception message ('budget'/'exceeded'/'insufficient'/'quota'). It works today, but is fragile against upstream message changes. Consider matching on emergentintegrations' typed exception (if available) or on a known error code. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:339-350.

The keyword 'exceeded' overlaps with non-billing errors (e.g. 'rate limit exceeded', 'context length exceeded'), which would incorrectly surface as 402 'out of credits'. Narrow the match to budget/credits/insufficient balance to avoid a misleading message. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:342.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Tighten the error-classification match in /api/memories/generate so words like 'exceeded' alone don't produce a 'out of credits' 402 — match on 'budget' or 'insufficient' or a typed exception from emergentintegrations.

(No blocker) Once the Universal Key budget is topped up, re-run the suite: the 3 currently-skipped tests (test_list_memories_contains_generated / test_get_memory_by_id / test_delete_memory_then_404) will exercise the real Gemini generation happy path automatically.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: except-branch classifies budget/quota errors and raises 402 with an actionable, user-facing detail. Other generation failures raise 400 with a friendly message — both are 4xx so the ingress does not rewrite them.
response_model=Memory does not interfere with HTTPException JSON — verified in test: content-type is application/json and body is {'detail': ...}.

rca_of_issue: Original bug (user reported): 'Something went wrong' toast on Generate. RCA: Emergent Universal LLM key budget exhausted ('Budget has been exceeded! Current cost 0.40, Max budget 0.4'); backend was returning 502 which the Kubernetes ingress rewrote, stripping the real JSON detail. Fix (verified this iteration): server.py:339-350 catches the LlmChat exception, and when the lowered message contains 'budget'/'exceeded'/'insufficient'/'quota' it raises HTTPException(402, detail='You're out of AI image credits. Add balance to your Emergent Universal Key ...'); all other generation exceptions raise a 400 with a friendlier message. Both are 4xx, so the ingress passes the JSON body through and the mobile client can display the actionable message. Reproduction: POST /api/memories/generate with a valid session + uploaded photo + non-empty prompt while the key budget is exhausted → HTTP 402 with the actionable JSON detail (confirmed). Mitigation for end users: top up the Universal Key balance.
